core_obligations: Reduce by base change and local structure: by descent it suffices to prove the statement after a flat finitely presented base change, and the local structure lemma presents the gerbe as a quotient stack over an algebraic space (proof lines 6293-6301)

Quotient case: the covering of the quotient is surjective flat and locally of finite presentation, and the permanence statements give the same properties for the structure morphism of the quotient (proof lines 6302-6315)
proof_roadmap: 由满/平坦/局部有限表现的下降引理，可先作平坦有限表现基变换。
由本地结构引理设 X = [U/G]；U → [U/G] 满平坦局部有限表现（gerbe-with-section），再由 permanence 得 π 本身满、平坦、局部有限表现。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the structure morphism of a gerbe over a base is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 6286-6291, label lemma-gerbe-fppf). The proof (source lines 6293-6316) reduces by the descent statements and the local structure of gerbes to the case of a quotient stack, where the covering of the quotient has the three properties and their permanence gives them for the structure morphism (proof lines 6293-6315). The reduction to a quotient stack is the substance. H3.
